notes.sessions: pools + unidentified completed a Cardano node-to-node handshake with this relay in the window
notes.flows_only: seen on the wire on this port but never established a session -- includes this relay's own failed outbound attempts
notes.unidentified: no pool registration resolves to this address. Block producers connect out without registering, and a pool's outbound source address is often not the address it registered for inbound, so this is not a count of unregistered relays.
